Detour now notes YouTube channels whose creators are also on ClockwiseTV.

### Added
- **ClockwiseTV channel banner.** [ClockwiseTV](https://www.clockwisetv.com/creators) is a curated, ad-free video app for kids aged 8 to 12, on iPhone, iPad and Android. On the YouTube channel pages of its creators, such as SciShow Kids, Crash Course Kids and MinuteEarth, Detour shows a banner that links to ClockwiseTV's creators page.
- ClockwiseTV has no web player, so the banner never redirects, and video pages are unchanged. It shows when **Show other platforms too** is on.
- The creator list comes from Detour's own hourly-updated list, so new ClockwiseTV creators appear without an extension update. Detour sends nothing to ClockwiseTV and needs no new permissions.

Everything else is as in [0.6.0](https://github.com/josh345rtfvqw/detour/releases/tag/v0.6.0).

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/detour-nebula-floatplane/), or load the zip below.
